text:
annie: heads up — found unredacted customer prompts saved in eval artifacts from the quantization bring-up CI run. looks like the runner wrote full request payloads to s3. :grimacing:
carol: seriously? :eyes: which job/paths?
annie: job: eval-runner/quantize-compat (on dedicated CI). examples under s3://redwood-evals/artifacts/2026-02-12/run-87/requests.jsonl
annie: snippet (redacted names here but original has clear account numbers):
```
{"request_id":"r-9f2a","prompt":"Transfer $500 from account 998877 to 112233","model":"redwood/opt-quant-v1"}
```
dan: this is a blocker for pushing any public evals or sharing artifacts. we need immediate containment: disable artifact upload for that CI pipeline and revoke the short-lived upload creds.
dan: opened infra ticket INF-842 and PR #5123 to stop saving full requests by default and to wire redaction hook into the runner. pinging @carol for review.
ci-bot: build 2789 (eval-runner/quantize-compat) failed — tests: runner-redaction-check. logs: https://ci.redwood.internal/build/2789 :warning:
sam: minimal checklist:
- turn off retention on the s3 path (temp prefix)
- run a quick scrub (aws s3 rm with --include)
- rotate the service token used by the runner
- add a unit test that asserts no PII-like patterns in artifacts
carol: agreed. I'll stop the job and grant you perms to scrub. also we should add a "pii_exposure" metric to the eval harness so we get automated alerts.
annie: for redaction hook I'm proposing config in the harness to declare fields to mask and a regex-based sanitizer. example config:
```yaml
redaction:
  enabled: true
  fields: ["prompt","user_input","metadata.customer_notes"]
  patterns:
    - "\b\d{9,}\b"   # long numeric tokens (acct/cc)
    - "\bssn\b"
```
carol: nice. also add deterministic seeding so we can reproduce failing runs without keeping raw payloads.
dan: can we avoid writing full request body to disk on runner failure? instead write only request_id + sanitized diff and a pointer to ephemeral debug workspace for on-call to fetch with additional auth.
dan: I'll update the runner to use per-customer randomized temp prefixes (not predictable) and to expire prefixes after 24h.
sam: test cases to add to CI:
- artifact contains no 9+ digit sequences
- requests.jsonl does not contain the string "account" followed by digits
- sanitizer is idempotent (apply twice, same result)

annie: I sanitized a backup locally and removed ~178 files from s3; will hand off to infra to double-check no copies remain.
carol: merged quick redaction patch to main (PR #5123). scheduling a lifecycle purge for the 2026-02-12 prefix. filing a low-severity security incident and notifying compliance.
ci-bot: incident created: INC-2026-114 (low) — owners: carol, dan, annie.
sam: follow-ups: add access control docs for eval artifacts, and add a dashboard tile in Redwood Console for pii_exposure by job.
carol: assigned. I'll open tickets for dashboard + metrics definitions. thanks everyone for the quick triage :thumbsup:
